title: Partition stale-label review by semantic context
failure_signature: A broad fixed-string probe conflated legitimate prior comparisons and secondary-pillar text with live stale labels.
trigger_preconditions: Historical and current vocabulary in one scope
candidate_workaround: Classify each hit as frozen x1, historical comparison, secondary pillar, or current x2 truth before issuing a stale-label verdict.
recurrence_guard: Do not equate a string hit with semantic staleness until its artifact stage and role are identified.
rollback: Retain the overbroad probe, rewrite no frozen x1 bytes, and publish a contextual receipt.
scope_boundary: This method validates contextual stale-label review only and does not establish broader semantic completeness.
